display.purpose: The Plotr name in the welcome window only.

headline.purpose: Page titles and the note title in the sheet.

title.purpose: Section, modal, empty-state and plot card titles.

title-sm.purpose: Board, type and Info Map card names; sidebar project name; current breadcrumb.

label.purpose: Meta lines, field labels, sidebar section heads, pills, segments. Sentence case.

caption.purpose: Plot label numbers, plot card location, key caps.

shadows.name: ring
shadows.purpose: Bare outline where a surface needs an edge but no lift.

shadows.name: shadow-card
shadows.purpose: Board, type and Info Map cards, settings groups, plot labels and act chips at rest.

shadows.name: shadow-card-hover
shadows.purpose: Hovered cards, paired with a 1-2px lift.

shadows.name: shadow-float
shadows.purpose: Floating canvas controls such as the zoom capsule.

shadows.name: shadow-modal
shadows.purpose: Modals, the search panel, the note sheet.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Default ease for state changes, fades and pop-ins.

motion.name: ease-glide
motion.purpose: Sliding and rising motion: segmented thumb, switch knob, sidebar collapse, sheets, modals.

motion.name: t-base
motion.purpose: Card lift, chevron rotation, header rule.

motion.name: sidebar-collapse
motion.purpose: Ctrl+\ sidebar collapse on the grid column.

motion.name: screen-crossfade
motion.purpose: View transition on the content area only; sidebar and header stay put.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All animations and transitions collapse under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled action per header or dialog, in the accent.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn ds-btn-primary"><svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg>New board</button>
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 13px; border: none; border-radius: var(--r-md, 9px); font-family: var(--font, 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 550; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent, #227A66); color: var(--on-accent, #FFFFFF); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.14), 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.12); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #1C6B59); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #227A66) 80%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: White button with a hairline ring for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn2 { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 13px; border: none; border-radius: var(--r-md, 9px); background: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); color: var(--text, #1D1D1F); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--separator-strong, rgba(0,0,0,0.14)), 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); font-family: var(--font, 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 550; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn2:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface, #FFFFFF), var(--text, #1D1D1F) 5%); } .ds-btn2:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn2:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #227A66) 80%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Header view toggles and quiet actions; the on state uses the accent wash.
components.css: .ds-ghost { height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: none; border-radius: var(--r-md, 9px); background: transparent; color: var(--text-2, #6E6E73); font-family: var(--font, 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-ghost:hover { background: var(--hover, rgba(0,0,0,0.045)); color: var(--text, #1D1D1F); } .ds-ghost--on, .ds-ghost--on:hover { background: var(--accent-soft, rgba(34,122,102,0.12)); color: var(--accent-text, #1E705D); } .ds-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #227A66) 80%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Ringed white field with an accent ring and halo on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 260px; height: 34px; padding: 0 11px; border: none; border-radius: var(--r-md, 9px); background: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); color: var(--text, #1D1D1F); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--separator-strong, rgba(0,0,0,0.14)); font-family: var(--font, 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 14.5px; transition: box-shadow 140ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-2, #6E6E73); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--accent, #227A66), 0 0 0 4px var(--accent-soft, rgba(34,122,102,0.12)); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Fill track with a white thumb that slides under the active item.
components.css: .ds-seg { position: relative; display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; height: 30px; padding: 2px; border-radius: var(--r-md, 9px); background: var(--fill, rgba(0,0,0,0.045)); font-family: var(--font, 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-seg__thumb { position: absolute; left: 2px; top: 2px; bottom: 2px; width: 52px; border-radius: var(--r-sm, 7px); background: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.5px rgba(0,0,0,0.06), 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.12); transition: transform 300ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1), width 300ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1); } .ds-seg__item { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 0 11px; border: none; background: none; border-radius: var(--r-sm, 7px); font: inherit; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 550; color: var(--text-2, #6E6E73); cursor: pointer; transition: color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-seg__item:hover, .ds-seg__item--on { color: var(--text, #1D1D1F); } .ds-seg__n { font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-2, #6E6E73); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-seg__item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #227A66) 80%, transparent); outline-offset: -1px; }

components.name: Sidebar Rows
components.description: Grey sidebar tree; the active row takes the accent wash and an accent-text icon.
components.css: .ds-sb { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; width: 228px; padding: 10px; background: var(--bg-sidebar, #F5F5F7); font-family: var(--font, 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-sb__row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 30px; padding: 0 8px; border: none; border-radius: var(--r-sm, 7px); background: transparent; color: var(--text, #1D1D1F); font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 450; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-sb__row svg { color: var(--text-2, #6E6E73); flex: none; } .ds-sb__row:hover { background: var(--hover, rgba(0,0,0,0.045)); } .ds-sb__row--on, .ds-sb__row--on:hover { background: var(--accent-soft, rgba(34,122,102,0.12)); font-weight: 560; } .ds-sb__row--on svg { color: var(--accent-text, #1E705D); } .ds-sb__row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #227A66) 80%, transparent); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Accent Pill
components.description: Capsule tag in the accent wash; neutral variant uses the fill.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 22px; padding: 0 9px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--accent-soft, rgba(34,122,102,0.12)); color: var(--accent-text, #1E705D); font-family: var(--font, 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-pill--neutral { background: var(--fill, rgba(0,0,0,0.045)); color: var(--text-2, #6E6E73); }

components.name: Board Card
components.description: Soft card with a live preview well; lifts on hover.
components.css: .ds-bcard { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 220px; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.06), 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04), 0 3px 10px -4px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--font, 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); transition: box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-bcard:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.07), 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.04), 0 14px 30px -10px rgba(0,0,0,0.16); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-bcard:active { transform: scale(0.99); } .ds-bcard:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #FFFFFF, 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, #227A66 80%, transparent); } .ds-bcard__prev { height: 116px; margin: 6px 6px 0; border-radius: 9px; background: var(--bg-sunken, #F3F3F5); overflow: hidden; } .ds-bcard__prev svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; } .ds-bcard__body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; padding: 11px 8px 12px 13px; } .ds-bcard__name { font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: var(--text, #1D1D1F); } .ds-bcard__meta { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--text-2, #6E6E73); }

components.name: Menu
components.description: Blurred material popover; rows fill with the accent on hover and focus.
components.css: .ds-menu { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 190px; padding: 5px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--material, rgba(252,252,253,0.8)); backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(180%); box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.5px rgba(0,0,0,0.12), 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.06), 0 14px 36px -6px rgba(0,0,0,0.2); font-family: var(--font, 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-menu__item { height: 29px; padding: 0 10px; border: none; border-radius: 7px; background: none; color: var(--text, #1D1D1F); font: inherit; font-size: 13.5px; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; outline: none; } .ds-menu__item:hover, .ds-menu__item:focus-visible { background: var(--accent, #227A66); color: var(--on-accent, #FFFFFF); } .ds-menu__item--danger { color: var(--danger-text, #C4000F); } .ds-menu__item--danger:hover, .ds-menu__item--danger:focus-visible { background: var(--danger, #D70015); color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-menu__sep { height: 1px; margin: 5px 8px; background: var(--separator, rgba(0,0,0,0.08)); }

components.name: Switch
components.description: Capsule switch; the knob glides and the track fills with the accent.
components.css: .ds-switch { position: relative; width: 38px; height: 22px; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--fill-strong, rgba(0,0,0,0.075)); cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-switch[aria-checked='true'] { background: var(--accent, #227A66); } .ds-switch__knob { position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 50%; background: #FFFFFF; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.5px rgba(0,0,0,0.06), 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.2); transition: transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1); } .ds-switch[aria-checked='true'] .ds-switch__knob { transform: translateX(16px); } .ds-switch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #227A66) 80%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Plotr is a modern desktop app in the Craft and Apple Notes family. A cool grey sidebar holds the whole project tree at all times. Beside it, a white content area carries boards as soft rounded cards, and notes rise as a centred document sheet over a blurred board. The writer never loses place: the tree stays put while only the content area crossfades.

The system is quiet and dense in the way a good Mac app is dense. Text is small (13.5px UI), grey is used for everything secondary, and one accent does all the pointing. Depth comes from soft, layered, offset shadows with a hairline ring, never from borders alone. Motion is short and eased, and the two signature motions are a sliding segmented thumb and a smooth plot curve. It rejects the editorial book costume and the flat developer-tool column.
keyCharacteristics: Two-pane frame: 248px grey sidebar, 52px header, white content column (max 1080px for pages).
Inter Variable for every word, including note prose; negative tracking on all headings.
One user-switchable accent (Pine default; Blue, Violet, Rose, Orange, Graphite).
Soft layered shadows with a 0.5-1px ring; cards lift 2px on hover.
Capsule chips, capsule zoom control, 9px controls, 14px cards, 16-18px sheets.
Blurred material on menus, the search panel, floating canvas controls and the sheet backdrop.
Full dark mode with a lighter accent text tone.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: The chrome has one saturated colour: the accent. Status, selection, the curve and the primary action all share it. Category colours are user data and live only on user content.

rules.name: The Two-Tone Accent Rule
rules.body: Accent as a fill uses the accent tone; accent as text or icon uses the accent text tone. Never set text in the fill tone.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: No uppercase, no letter-spaced small caps anywhere. Section heads such as "Boards" are sentence case at 12.5px/600 in secondary grey.

rules.name: The Tabular Count Rule
rules.body: Counts, zoom values and plot numbers use tabular figures.

rules.name: The Ring, Not Border Rule
rules.body: Surfaces outline with a box-shadow ring (1px at rest, 0.5px on floating layers), not a CSS border. The dashed "New board" tile and Info Map groups are the only bordered shapes.

rules.name: The Blur Means Floating Rule
rules.body: Backdrop blur appears only on layers above the content: menus, search, the zoom capsule, tool rails, and modal and sheet backdrops.

dos: Do use the accent role tokens for every accent use, so all six accents and dark mode follow.
Do outline surfaces with the ring inside the shadow stack, and lift hoverable cards 1-2px with the Card Hover shadow.
Do keep UI text at 13.5px and meta at 12.5px in secondary grey; add hierarchy with weight and tight negative tracking.
Do use capsules for chips, pills, switches and floating controls, and keep nested radii concentric.
Do put blurred material only on layers that float above content.

Do ease state changes in 140-200ms on `cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)` and sliding or rising motion in 260-340ms on `cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1)`; crossfade only the content area between screens; drop all motion under reduced motion.
donts: Don't use a serif, a typewriter face, or a second sans; Inter carries every word, prose included.
Don't set labels in uppercase or letter-spaced small caps.
Don't add a second saturated chrome colour; category colours stay on user content.
Don't draw hard, zero-blur offset shadows or solid 1px borders around cards.
Don't hard-code the pine hex in new components.
